subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode surface an exhausted binding quota when another quota family remains usable, using reset-focused selection in the menu bar and maximum-usage selection in Overview?
rationale: Current tests establish the opposite usable-window preference, while this PR introduces context-specific semantics that require an explicit product choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt context-specific semantics
options.body: Use exhausted/reset-aware selection for the provider menu-bar metric while ranking Overview by the maximum used quota, as this PR proposes.

options.title: Preserve usable-lane selection
options.body: Keep the existing behavior that prevents an exhausted bucket from replacing another usable automatic metric window.

options.title: Use one constrained lane everywhere
options.body: Select the same most-constrained quota window for both display and ranking to avoid divergent consumer semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Use exhausted/reset-aware selection for the provider menu-bar metric while ranking Overview by the maximum used quota, as this PR proposes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner merged the underlying quota surface and is the strongest available owner for its user-visible selection policy.
